domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domain names, website URLs or email addresses (the host is extracted). Subdomains are kept intact, e.g. mail.example.com. Duplicates are looked up once.

recordTypes.title: Record types
recordTypes.description: Which record types to resolve and return per domain. Types not selected are returned as null.

stripWww.title: Strip leading www.
stripWww.description: If enabled, a leading "www." is removed before lookup (mail.example.com and other subdomains are always kept as-is).
